purpose: Search and invoke host command items in a shared dialog-backed command palette.
behaviorProvider: Base UI Dialog and Autocomplete primitives plus local query filtering and shortcut handling.

requirements.statement: Support controlled open/onOpenChange or defaultOpen local state. The internal setOpen(false) path clears query; an external controlled close alone need not reset it.
Filter supplied command labels and keywords by a case-insensitive substring match, preserving optional grouping. An optional AI action is appended by component logic.
Delegate dialog focus containment, list highlighting and selection keyboard behavior to Base UI Dialog and Autocomplete rather than implementing a separate toolbar model.
When enabled, listen for document Ctrl+K or Meta+K and toggle open. The handler does not exclude editable targets; hosts may disable the shortcut where it conflicts.
Close through the local setOpen path before invoking the selected item callback. Displayed item shortcut labels do not register separate keyboard shortcuts.
Initially focus the search and remember the opener; return focus to the connected opener on dismissal unless the host has already moved focus outside the dialog.
Provide stable command identifiers, meaningful labels and callbacks. Handle promise errors, navigation completion, authorization and destructive confirmation in the action implementation.
Avoid competing global shortcuts and duplicate palettes, apply controlled open callbacks, and provide a discoverable trigger when a keyboard shortcut is insufficient.
Own pattern or component styling consumes navigation group tokens. Nested shared components retain their own group ownership; do not restyle their internals.

limitations: No command authorization, persistence, asynchronous action lifecycle or automatically wired per-item shortcuts.
The global open shortcut also runs while an editable element is focused.
Query clearing is tied to internal close requests, not every possible controlled prop transition.
